Commentary.Commentary: One would say this is India's game to lose from here after a splendid bowling performance. But you never know, with some early wickets and quick short balls anything is possible. Up next is the Indian run chase.

India were excellent in the field. They bowled perfect lines at the start and didn't allow any of the Englishmen to get under them. The spin twins, known as 'Kulcha' did their work in the middle overs. The visitors got back in the game well after the openers took off, thanks to one man - Kuldeep Yadav. The chinaman got his first 6-wicket haul in ODIs and the home team didn't have an answer to his bowling. Umesh picked up two wickets at the death and ensured that England did not cross the 270-mark. Kaul had a decent debut but no wickets to show for.

The English openers started off well and got them to a good start. This is interesting, they both made 38 off 35 balls and got out to Kuldeep. The hosts then lost quick wickets but Buttler and Stokes gave them some hope with a 93-run stand. The duo got to their respective fifties but Ben ate up a lot of balls which is unlike him. Towards the end, Adil Rashid scored some vital boundaries which helped England post a fighting total on the board.
England are all out within their 50 overs. Something they would have not thought of, especially after making a record 481 the last time they batted here. Excellent stuff from the Indians.

OUT! It's all over! Full and wide, Plunkett chops it through point and starts running immediately. Raina at deep backward point gets the ball and throws it back quickly to MSD. Liam comes back for the second but he was always going to be second best. Dhoni removes the bails and as a result, ENGLAND ARE BOWLED OUT FOR 268!
Plunkett gives this a full swing of the bat, and connects. They manage to come back for the second.
FOUR! Full around off, crashed through long off by big Plunkett. A boundary results. How many more can the home team get off the last three balls?
Mark Wood is the next batsman in.

OUT! Gone! Straight into Pandya's big bucket hands. Adil Rashid will be sad considering he middled it. The ball goes in the air but straight to the fielder at extra cover who doesn't even have to move to take the catch. England lose their 9th for 261.
A low full toss outside off, Liam swings his bat and gets it to mid-wicket off the inner half of the bat. One run taken.
Full in line of the stumps, pushed to mid-wicket for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. One run added to the total.

FOUR! And another! Adil is toying with Kaul here. He bowls a length ball this time but Rashid cleverly plays the scoop off the bottom edge and manages to get it past MSD behind the stump for a boundary.

SIX! Scooped and scooped handsomely for a maximum. Adil tried this a couple of times before but this time he gets it nicely. A fuller ball in line of the stumps, Adil moves across and presents the inclined bat to the ball. He gets it cleanly to send it over the fine leg fence.
Full into Liam who clips it to long on for a single.
On a length in line of the stumps, Adil gets and inside edge to it and changes strike.
Rashid has done well to keep that yorker at bay. One run added to the total.
A touch in line of the stumps, Rashid looks to scoop it to the fine leg region but gets a bottom edge to the keeper.
Liam Plunkett is the next batsman in.

OUT! And Yadav has the last laugh! A nice little cameo from Ali comes to an end. A length ball on the pads, he lifts it off the middle of the bat to mid-wicket but couldn't clear Virat stationed there. An easy catch from the skipper to end the left-hander's 24 off 23-ball innings.
FOUR! Too full outside off, Ali moves his right leg to make room and gets under the ball well. He chops it over the third man region and the ball goes to the boundary. 10 off 2 for Ali.

SIX! Short and punished! Take this Umesh. What a hit from Ali. A touch too straight targeting the ribs of the batsman who swivels and connects the pull nicely. The ball sails into the crowd at the square leg region. A welcome maximum this for England, one after the 19th over.
Full on off, Rashid looks to slog it across but only manages to get it to mid on for a run.
Yorker! Ali digs it out back to the bowler.
FOUR! BANG! Nicely driven through covers by Ali. It was asking to punished to be honest. Full around off and a lot of room for the left-hander who doesn't miss out on a scoring opportunity.
Another shortish delivery and pulled away for a run.
Short and in line of the Rashid. He pulls it and somehow manages to get it to square leg amidst a bit of a tangle. A wayward throw from Hardik from the deep means a brace is taken.
FOUR! On a length on off, Adil stays on the leg side of the delivery and gets it up and over the bowler's head. A boundary results through the long on region.
Hangs back and blocks the length delivery out.
Siddarth Kaul comes to bowl.
Short and wide, Adil flashes his bat from his crease and gets it to the extra cover for a run.
On the pads this time, Ali punches it to the square leg region. One run taken.
Angles it into Rashid who works it to square leg and changes strike.
Pushed through the point region for another single.
Similar length in line of the stumps, Adil guides it to the on side for a run.

Another brilliant effort from the debutant Siddarth as he saves a couple of runs for his team. Umesh bowls a back of length ball outside off, Adil pokes at it and gets an outside edge. The ball flies to the third man region where Kaul runs to his left and puts in dive to save the runs.
Adil Rashid comes to the crease. Umesh Yadav comes in to bowl over for India.

OUT! Would you believe it? A nothing ball and Kuldeep gets his sixth on the very last ball of his spell. Way too short from Yadav on middle and leg, Willey rocks back and looks to clear Trent Bridge with a mighty pull. He finds KL at cow corner who does not drop those. Another two-wicket over and England are losing their way towards the end.
Quicker one in line of the stumps, Willey hits it back to the bowler.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Sharp turn from Yadav on off, Willey pushes this to the off side to get off the mark.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
David Willey replaces Ben Stokes in the middle.

OUT! Fifer for Kuldeep Yadav! A richly deserved five wickets and Ben Stokes has to take the long walk back after a rather miserable time out in the middle. Tossed up ball on off, Stokes looks to up his strike rate by reverse sweeping this one. The ball flies towards backward point where the debutant Kaul dives to his right to take a superman catch. Stunning effort to give Kuldeep his first 5-wicket haul.
Kuldeep Yadav to bowl his last over.
Played through mid-wicket by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Full this time, Ali throws the kitchen sink at it but only gets one as the fielder at cow corner cleans up.
Another short ball from Kaul. Ali goes for the pull but gets hit on the helmet. No damage done but that's four dot balls in a row.
Perfect line from Kaul. Not giving Moeen any room. Pushes this to the off side for nothing.
Effort ball from Kaul, Ali dabs it to backward point.
Short ball, Moeen pulls this towards mid-wicket.
Siddarth Kaul to bowl his 8th over.
Back of a length ball outside off, Stokes punches this to covers and stays on 49.
Wide. Stokes tries flicking a ball that is down the leg side. The umpire signals a wide.
Played to mid-wicket region by Ben.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Hits this towards mid off and gives his partner the strike.
Goes back and punches this to the off side.
Back of a length ball, Stokes it happy to block it. A very unlike Stokes innings this.
Umesh Yadav to bowl at the death.
Seeing Moeen going for the sweep, Chahal drags his length back a bit. Ali misses his short to get hit on his shoulders.
Short ball, Stokes goes back and pulls it back to the deep square leg region. A good effort from Pandya to strict it to a run.
Flighted ball on middle, Ali sweeps this to square leg for a run.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Guides this to the off side to get off strike.
Googly. Ali delicately works it fine down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Jaffa! Slower ball on middle and off, Stokes looks to fiddle with it but cannot connect.
Hits this towards mid on for one more.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.
Quicker one on middle, Stokes rocks back and cuts it through point for a run.
Taps this to the cover fielder and quickly gets to the other end.
Short ball on off, enough time for  Moeen to punch it to the off side for one.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings.
Brings out the reverse sweep to this fuller ball but gloves it on the off side.
Top edge but it's safe. Tossed right up there, Stokes gets low to sweep and top edges it over short fine leg. A couple of runs are taken.
Turns this with the wrists off the front foot to deep mid-wicket. The 200 is up for England with this.
Loopy and full on middle and off, the leg break, Moeen Ali comes half-forward as he defends it on the leg side.
Down the leg side, easy enough for the batsman to nudge it down to fine leg for one.
Quicker through the air on middle and off, Stokes uses the depth of the crease as he blocks this one right under his nose.
Moeen Ali walks out to the middle. Also, Yuzvendra Chahal is brought back on to bowl.

OUT! There it is! Kuldeep gets his fourth and breaks the 93-run stand. Floats this down leg, Buttler goes onto his back foot and looks to flick this fine. Ends up getting a feather behind and Dhoni takes a lovely catch after being blind-sighted for sometime. A good partnership for England, but it's ended at a wrong time for them. They needed a set Buttler towards the fag end. Now, the rest to follow will have to carry on from here.
Pushes this towards mid on for a run.
Drags his length back and Ben punches this through covers for a brace.
Sharp turn for Yadav. Tosses this one on middle and it goes past the outside edge of Stokes.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Leg spin on off, Stokes plays and misses.
Kuldeep Yadav is asked to bowl.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Strays this down leg, Stokes goes for the flick but does not connect. Wide not given. Must have got something off Stokes on the way to MS.
Smart bowling from Pandya. Saw Stokes charging and bowls in a short ball. Cramps Stokes for room who can only manage to get a bottom edge to the keeper.
Short of a length ball, Ben hits it back to the bowler.
Buttler rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to the off side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Buttler has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but Jos still goes after it. Wide signalled by the umpire.
Good over from Kaul. Just the three from it. Bowls this full around off, Buttler hits it towards long off to keep strike.
Good ball. Back of a length in line of the stumps, Buttler defends it from his crease.
Stokes gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to sweeper cover. They pick up a single.
Short ball on the stumps, Stokes hits it to mid on.
Punched off the back foot to the cover-point fielder.
Pitched up ball around off, Buttler drives it through covers to give his partner the strike.
Three fifties in a row for Buttler. His 18th overall. He is in a purple patch of his own. Punches this ball to the off side to get to the landmark.
Buttler has flicked the ball off his pads to the deep square leg region. They manage to come back for the second.
Back of a length ball on middle, Jos gets it off the inner half towards mid on.
Short again outside off, Buttler cannot get it past the gully fielder.
Short ball outside off, Stokes gets it off the bottom edge towards third man for one more.
Buttler opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. They pick up a single.
Hardik Pandya is brought in for another spell.
Punches this off the back foot to the off side to end the over with a single.

Excellent running. As soon as the ball touches the bat, Stokes calls for the run. This is a full ball from Kaul around off. Stokes plays it with soft hands to mid off and in the end completes the single easily.
Fuller ball on off, Buttler straight drives this along the turf for one.
Stokes opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Stokes taps it towards mid on and charges for a run. Is rightly send back by his partner.
Played through mid-wicket by Stokes. Dot ball.
FOUR! A boundary to finish the over. That is Buttler's area. Half volley from Yadav and Jos drives it with confidence through covers.
Pitches this up around off, this time Jos hits it in the gap to extra cover for a brace.
Back of a length ball on off, Butter stays back and gives it back to the bowler.
On middle and leg, Buttler cannot get it past the mid-wicket fielder.
Fuller this time on off, Buttler takes a step ahead and drives to the man at short covers.
Length ball outside off, Stokes dabs it to third man for a run.
Drinks break!
Hurls this on a good length around off, it jags back a bit. Buttler turns his bat to the leg and hits the ball to deep square leg. Will get two runs for it.
In line of the stumps, Buttler is solid in his defense.
Fuller ball outside off, Stokes guides it to third man for a easy run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Length on that fourth stump channel, Stokes hits it towards covers and sprints to get to the other end.
Back of a length ball around off, Buttler punches it through covers for a run.
Siddarth Kaul is called back into the attack.
Finds the gap this time as he gets it past the cover fielder. Single taken.
Pushed to the covers this time. Straight to the fielder.
Good length ball outside off, Buttler punches it with an open face to point.
Good placement. Buttler plays the punch wide enough from sweeper cover. Is able to come back for the second as a result.
Fraction straight in line, on a length, flicked to deep mid-wicket. Easy run collected.
Back of a length around off, Stokes blocks it right beside the pitch with soft hands.
Umesh Yadav to bowl again.
A bit too full, outside off, Stokes presses forward and punches it through covers. Retains strike with a run.
Spinning in, on middle, forces Buttler to go back and offer a firm punch down to long on for a single.
Nice and full and straight from Kuldeep, Buttler is forward in defense.
A little turn away this time, outside off, Stokes has some room to work with as he rocks back and cuts it to sweeper cover. One run to the scoreboard.
Slower through the air, on the stumps again, blocked off the outer half. The ball rolls away towards point.
Fuller in line of the stumps, driven to long on for a single.
Driven towards the mid off region. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Positions himself to get behind the line and defends.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Loopy from Chahal, Stokes gets low and brings out the reverse sweep, only to find the man at short third man.
Jos stays leg side. Opens his body up and drives the full ball through the covers for a run.
Loopy delivery on middle and leg, worked through square leg using the depth of the crease. Single results. The 50-run stand is up as well.
Drives it to long off for one run. Just 1 off the over, good work from the chinaman.
Worked away on the leg side. Dot ball.
Straighter one, nudged to mid-wicket.

Loud appeal for an lbw, turned down. Was missing leg and also pitched outside the line of leg stump. So good call from the umpire. Outside leg and then turns in, Stokes looks to go leg side but misses.
A back foot defensive shot offered in response to the quicker delivery from Kuldeep.
Turning away from around off, Stokes hits it down to short third man.

That must be a nasty blow! Ouch. He seems fine but that must have stung. Buttler takes the run on after pushing it towards covers. Hardik takes the ball and fires it at Chahal's end. Misses the stumps and instead hits the leggie on the inside of the knee.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! The googly comes from Chahal but he throws it way outside off, Buttler is easily able to drive this through the covers and beat the dive from the fielder in the deep.
Quicker and straighter, blocked.
FOUR! Lovely from Buttler. The moment the ball left Chahal's hand, he knew what he was going to do. Picked his spot, went inside out over covers and found the fence, beating the man in the deep.
Short, flat and turning in on leg, Stokes is back in flash as he whips it through towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Stays back and presents a straight blade in defense.
Sliding in from around off, Stokes backs away, gets cramped for room but still is able to force it to extra cover for a run.
Quite full outside off, turning in, Buttler with a simple push to long off to get off strike.
Earns a single by knocking this to long off. Comfortably done.
Comes forward to this tossed up delivery, gets close to the pitch and sees it out.
Bowls this a touch quicker through the air in line of the stumps, Big Ben blocks.
Kuldeep Yadav returns.
Comes forward, reaches out to it and drives it to wide long off. Single to end the over.
Waits for the ball to turn and come to him, the southpaw presents a solid defensive shot.
Goes leg side again. A fraction straight in line, Buttler goes inside the crease and turns it through square leg. One run to the total.
Flicked past the diving mid-wicket fielder. Nicely done, another run taken.
A lot of air on this one, Buttler clears his front leg and pushes it back past the bowler. Long on moves across to his left and cuts it off, keeps the batsmen down to just one.
Leg break on middle and leg, Stokes picks it off his pads and nudges it in front of square leg. Big gap out there, he's easily able to manage a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Shot. That is amazing. Shot of a man oozing class. Full on the stumps, Buttler makes room, takes his front leg out of the way and drills it through the covers. Boundary.
Guides this down to third man off the outer half and comes back for the second.
Length ball outside off, it holds its line, Buttler plays inside the line and gets beaten. The ball goes to Dhoni on a couple of bounces.
Moves inside the line to this length ball on middle and off, works it to the man at mid-wicket.
FOUR! Edged and away! Length ball around off, Buttler hangs his bat out and gets an edge through the vacant slip cordon. Nobody out there in the deep, it'll run away for a boundary.
FOUR! Landed short and he's been punished for it. Wide outside off, Stokes rocks back and cuts it square through point for a boundary.
Pushed off the front foot to the covers.
Full and slow, a lot of air on this time, Stokes clears his front leg and blocks.
Eased down to long off for a single.
A bit too full this time, the ball has no room to turn and Buttler takes advantage of this by wristing it through mid-wicket. Picks up two for doing so.
Tossed up leg break on the stumps, Stokes flicks it with the spin to deep mid-wicket and takes one.
Leans ahead and knocks it through to long off for one.
Beaten! Good comeback from Hardik. Slants across a length delivery around off, Stokes gets beaten on his attempted defensive shot.

FOUR! That's a really good shot from Ben Stokes! Touch short outside off, the big all-rounder gets on top of the bounce and then cracks it superbly through the covers for a boundary. The man in the deep had no chance.
Peach! Length delivery on off, moves away ever so much and quite late too. Almost done Stokes in who hangs his bat to block and gets beaten past the outside edge.
Walks down the track to get close to the pitch and defends again.
Length ball around off, shaping away, Stokes comes forward only to block.
Hit down to long off comfortably and a single is collected.
Blocked right under his nose with a straight blade.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Driven along the ground to mid on. Dot ball.
Landed on leg, Stokes gets low to sweep but misses.
Full on middle and leg, flicked towards short mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a good effort to dive low to his right and stop it from going past him.
Full on the stumps, flicked straight to short mid-wicket to end the over.
Seeing the ball landing on the shorter side outside off, Stokes slaps this punch through the gap in the covers and crosses over.
Outside off on a good length, punched to point for nothing.
Just ahead of a length on off, Buttler moves forward and across before flicking it in front of square leg for a run.
Stokes opens the bat face and runs it down to third man for one. The ball was slanting away so he used the angle well.
Short of a good length outside the line of off stump, pushed away softly into the off side.
Eases this full ball to long off by coming forward and takes one.
Stays firm in the crease and defends.
Ben Stokes has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Off the mark immediately as Buttler drives it towards mid off for a single.

OUT! GONE! The bowling change works wonders. Chahal dismisses the English skipper who was looking to cut loose now. Slower through the air, Morgan is deceived by the flight as he goes into the flick shot a little too early. Chips it straight towards Raina who gets low and takes a solid catch. Timely wicket for the Men in Blue. Meanwhile, Jos Buttler is the next batsman in.
Plays this with the spin and wrists it towards mid on for a run.
Yuzvendra Chahal back on.

FOUR! 12 runs off the over, a much-needed and a good one for the hosts. Pandya bends his back and fires it full outside off, Morgan plants his front foot forward and thumps it down the ground for a boundary.
SIX! Shot! Latched on to that one in a flash! Banged in short, Morgan rises on his toes and muscles the pull flat over the mid-wicket boundary for a maximum.
Bit of a mistimed shot from Eoin Morgan. Wanted to drive it hard through the covers but ended up playing it tamely to mid off.
A run taken. Stokes goes in the same area as his skipper, stands tall and slaps it through to sweeper cover.
Back of a length, going away from outside off, Morgan reaches out to it and slaps it to sweeper cover for a single.
Slanting away from around off, Morgan shoulders arms to let that one through.
Hardik Pandya into the attack.
Spinning away from around off, some extra bounce as the batsman opens the face and dabs it to point. Aside from the boundary, another good over from Suresh Raina.
Leans ahead to this full ball, goes down the ground but can't beat mid on.
Shorter in length, which makes Stokes go back and punch the ball to covers.
Driven neatly through the covers for one.
Darted quicker and fuller on the stumps, driven back to the bowler.

FOUR! That should relieve some pressure. Raina lands it short on the stumps, Morgan picks it up early, goes deep inside the crease and heaves it over mid-wicket. A couple of bounces and that's a boundary.
Another defensive shot offered. This is excellent bowling from the Indian spinners, applying tremendous pressure on the Englishmen.
Oh that was close! Good bowling from Kuldeep. He brings out the googly and almost takes Stokes by surprise as he is a touch late in getting his bat down to ball.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Hangs back inside the crease and defends.
Quite slow through the air, Kuldeep drags his length back a touch, it's driven to long off for a run.
Nice flight offered from the chinaman, drops it on a driving length on off, it turns away as Stokes defends from the crease.
Full and quick outside off, Morgan forces this through to long off for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side this time, wide called by the umpire.
Knocks it down the ground, towards long on and changes ends.
Punched back down the track, right at the bowler.
Minimal spin, on off, Ben defends it right under his nose.
Uses the depth of the crease this time, goes back and works it to the man at mid-wicket.
Full and straight from Raina, Stokes takes a big stride forward and guards it out.
Drinks break!
Tossed up delivery which is blocked off solidly.

Chance of a run out! Close. That's what pressure does to you. After 10 dots in a row, Stokes works this away towards square leg and takes off for a risky run. Hardik gets to the ball swiftly, picks it up with one hand and fires it at the bowler's end. Big Ben dives as the throw misses. Would have been close had it hit.
Opens the face of the bat and taps it to point with the spin.
Not much spin on this occasion, Stokes camps back and blocks.
Slower through the air and outside off, pushed to the cover area from the front foot.
Unlike Raina, Kuldeep loops this up and keeps it full on off, Stokes prods forward and keeps it out.
Maiden over from Raina! Lovely stuff. Darts it quicker again on a shorter length, Morgan hangs back to block.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Cramps Morgan for room, who can only force it off the back foot towards cover.
Fullish in length and outside off, punched to the right of the bowler who makes a diving save.
Another one quicker through the air, close to off, defended with a straight blade.
Flatter and quicker outside off, Morgan stays back and punches it covers.
Now then, Suresh Raina has been handed the ball.
Defended off the front foot by Stokes presenting the full face of the bat. Kuldeep's figure read 2-0-7-3.
Ben Stokes is the new man in.

OUT! India have got the review spot on. Three red lights and England lose their third wicket giving Kuldeep another one. Yadav bowls a googly on leg, it spins sharply and hits the back leg of Bairstow after he misses his shot. Kohli and his men appeal but the umpire probably thinks it was pitching outside leg. The Indian players have a chat and take it up. Replays show us that the ball was pitching on leg and going on to hit the off stump. Rejoice among the Indian players.
An LBW decision is taken upstairs.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Tossed up ball on off, Bairstow drives it to the man at covers.
The batsman has driven it through mid off. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Eoin Morgan, the ODI skipper comes in place of his Test skipper.

OUT! Plumb! Root has missed the ball completely and gets caught in front of the stump. England have lost two quick wickets now. Yadav gives this air outside off, it spins in sharply. Root shows the full face of the bat and looks to block it but is beaten all ends up. The players appeal and the umpire doesn't take time in raising his finger. Root walks and decides not to review it. He knows what he has done. Kuldeep has two now. This phase of spin has given India their first and England will need to be careful now.
Plays this with soft hands to the short fine leg fielder for one more.
The batsman has been struck on the thigh pad.
England happy to nudge the ball and pick up the singles. This one is played towards mid-wicket for another run.
Pushed to the cover region by Joe. One run added to the total.
Root has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Leg spinner on off, Bairstow drives this towards mid off for a run.
Change of ends for Yuzvendra Chahal.
Nudges this down towards square leg to retain strike.
Plays this with soft hands towards the leg side for nothing.
Bairstow has played it fine down the leg side. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
And Root is off the mark. Taps this towards mid-wicket for a run.
Joe Root, England's Test skipper, walks out to bat.

OUT! First blow for England. And Kuldeep Yadav strikes on his very second ball. One time too many from Roy and the reverse sweep leads to his downfall. Kuldeep Floats this down the leg side, Roy reaches for it and looks to hit another one like he did in Chahal's over. Doesn't get the desired connection and the ball goes straight in the hands of Umesh Yadav at cover-point.
Tosses this on leg, Roy paddles this down to the fine leg region for another couple of runs.
Powerplay 2 has been signalled by the umpire. Four players are now allowed to stay outside the circle and Kuldeep Yadav replaces his fellow spin twin.
Roy opens the face of the bat and helps it to the fielder at gully. They pick up a single.
Jason has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Length this time on off, Roy Drives it in the gap through covers for a brace.
Roy rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball to the off side.
FOUR! Short ball from Hardik around off, Roy stays back and pulls this through square leg. A boundary results.
Bairstow has flicked the ball off his pads. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Hardik Pandya to bowl the last over of the Powerplay.
FOUR! Improvisation from Roy and will get four for it. Tossed up down leg from Yuzi, Roy reverse sweeps it through point for a boundary.
Wrong one from Chahal. It takes the inside edge of the bat and hits Roy on his pads.
Leg breaker on off, Jonny taps it to the off side for a run.
Played through mid-wicket by Roy. The batsmen have run through for a single.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and defends it.
Leg break on off, Bairstow drives it through covers for a single.
Spin time, Yuzvendra Chahal will bowl his first over before the 10th over.
Gets this a bit far of the covers fielder which enables him to take the run.
Corrects his length now bowling it full, JB drives it to covers.
SIX! Boom! First of many of the day. Kaul bowls the effort ball on off, it sits up nicely for Bairstow who pulls it effortlessly over mid-wicket for a maximum. What a way to get to the 50-run stand.
Drives it to mid off to the fielder.
Length ball outside off, Roy taps it towards gully and responds to Jonny's call. Dhawan there, picks it up and has a shy at the striker's end. He misses but JB was well in. Good running.
Fullish ball on leg, Bairstow hits it to mid on and hares to get to the other end.
Yorker to end the over. Full and outside off, Roy does well to get bat to it.
Full on off, Roy drives in towards cover-point for nothing.
Bairstow has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Played to the point region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
FOUR! And he will get four more! Back of a length ball outside off, Roy waits for it and at the last moment guides it towards third man for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Length ball around off, Roy cuts this through point for another boundary. England have started well here.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! This has been powered to the boundary. Full ball around off, Roy watches the ball carefully and hits it aerially through covers to the fence.
Corrects his length by bowling it full on off, Jonny hits it towards mid off and sprints to complete the run.
FOUR! Length ball outside off and Bairstow finds the gap to perfection. Transfers his weight to his back foot and punches it along the turf for a boundary.
Length on off, Bairstow punches it to the off side.
On middle and leg, Roy hits it towards mid on for a single.
FOUR! One ball he misses his line and gets the punishment. Angles this down leg, Bairstow just helps it on it's way and the ball runs to the fine leg region.
Driven through mid off by the batsman. One run added to the total.
DROPPED! A tough chance but it's a chance nonetheless. Fuller this time on off, Roy hits it uppishly down the ground. Umesh gets his left arm out but the ball doesn't stick. How costly will this be?
Pin-point stuff. Length on off, Roy watches it carefully and bunts it down.
Spot on once again. A tad back of a length just outside the off pole, Roy hits it back to the bowler.
Length ball on that fourth stump line, Roy cuts it to point. Good bowling from the Indians. Bowling a good line and not giving these openers any room to play with.
Good over from Kaul. Just a run from it. Another fuller ball on off, Bairstow drives it to covers.
Hurls this full around off, Jonny gives it to Rohit at covers to collect.
Back of a length again outside off, Roy stays back and punches it to covers for a run.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, Roy hops back and defends it.
That ball has struck the batsman on the thigh pad.
Roy drives this pitched up ball to mid off. No run taken.
Length ball on off, Bairstow gets it off the inner half of the bat onto his pads. Good over for England.
Driven to mid off again but this time to the man stationed there.
FOUR! Even better! Juicy half volley from Yadav on off, Bairstow stands tall and drives a punch in the gap through covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Classical! Umesh pitches this right on top in search of swing. The ball doesn't do much and Bairstow plays a lovely straight drive to get four.
Edged but well short. Back of a length ball on off, Roy fishes for it and gets an outside edge short of the man at gully. They complete the single with ease.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Darts this full now outside off, Jonny finds the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Bangs this one short on middle and leg, Bairstow waits for it and pulls it with force to the deep square leg region for a boundary.
Length on leg, Jonny can't find the gap and hits it to mid-wicket.
Back of a length ball on middle and leg, JB taps it to mid on.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Pitches it up on off and Roy drives it solidly to covers. A misfield there enables them to take a run.
Siddarth Kaul, the debutant, to bowl his first over from the other end.

Loud appeal from the players but the umpire stays put. Yadav hurls this around off, it nips back in and strikes the back leg of Bairstow as he looks to turn the ball to the leg side. The Indian players go up in unison but the umpire says no. They think of the review but decide against it. Eventful over comes to an end.
Wide. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it. The umpire signals a wide.
Fuller this time on off, Jonny drives it to covers.
Great ball. On middle and off, Bairstow plays and misses.
Leg bye. Strays this down leg and Roy misses his flick. Gets hit on the thigh pad and they steal a leg bye.
Length this time on middle, Roy blocks it with a straight bat.

FOUR! Where is second slip? That would have been an easy take for him. Positive start for the bowler. Steams in from over the wicket and pitches it around off in search of swing. He gets decent movement and the ball shapes away after pitching. Roy goes for it and gets an edge flying past the diving first slip fielder. No third man and the ball races away.

The Indian players along with the umpires step onto the green surface of Trent Bridge. English openers Jason Roy and Jonny Bairstow stride out to take center stage. Umesh Yadav, in the absence of Bhuvi will open the bowlers for the visitors. A slip in place. Here we go.

Eoin Morgan says they would have also liked to chase. Adds that the wicket looks good and runs can be scored here. Mentions that Alex Hales is injured so Dawid Malan comes in his place, which means that Joe Root will play at no.3 and Ben Stokes at 4. States that Root is a quality player who sets high standards for himself, and he's hungry to score runs after a quiet summer so far.

Virat Kohli says they will bowl first as the wicket is hard, much like the one in Manchester the other day. States that they will focus on their strengths and the wrist spinners in his side will have a key role to play in the middle overs. Despite the World Cup coming up, he reckons that no team is really looking at the rankings and everyone, including themselves, will want to play their best game. Is aware that England gave them a stern challenge back home in India, so will want his team to put its best foot forward.
Toss - India win the toss and opt to bowl first.

For English fans, yesterday's heartbreak must have not yet sunk in. Football might not have brought the joy they were looking for, but Eoin Morgan and his men might. So, for now, let's focus on the cricket. India got the better of the hosts in the T20Is and before they prepare for the much-anticipated Test series, these ODIs will serve as more than sufficient preparation, at least in terms of getting used to conditions. The two sides stand on top of the rankings at the moment and we can expect more than a cracker of a series. Trent Bridge is the venue for the first match. The last time a game was played here, England made a record 481 runs. We don't think the surface will change much so brace yourselves for a run feast. Alex Hales will miss out the first ODI because of injury, and it will be a big loss for the home team as he has a great record on this pitch. For India, it seems that Bhuvneshwar Kumar will not be fit enough to start. Will be interesting to see who makes way into the XI. Toss and team news coming up in a bit.
